description: Reusable starter template for legal, medical, accounting, finance, HR, and operations document extraction workflows.

extracted_fields.name: primary_subject
extracted_fields.label: Primary Subject
extracted_fields.description: The main subject, entity, patient, client, account, contract, or matter described by the document.
extracted_fields.instructions: Extract the primary named subject exactly as stated in the document.

extracted_fields.name: effective_date
extracted_fields.label: Effective Date
extracted_fields.description: The date the document, service, agreement, or record takes effect.
extracted_fields.instructions: Extract the most relevant effective, service, filing, or issue date and normalize it when possible.

extracted_fields.name: total_amount
extracted_fields.label: Total Amount
extracted_fields.description: The primary total monetary amount stated in the document, if applicable.
extracted_fields.instructions: Extract the main total amount only when the document clearly states one.

calculated_fields.name: amount_with_buffer
calculated_fields.label: Amount With Buffer
calculated_fields.description: Example calculated field that applies a 10 percent buffer to the extracted total amount.
